descriptionHtml:
Candidate N35 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Notes from the new SNF consult / SNF discharge templates add things the physician never said: an invented consult service, delirium or heart-failure impressions, 'monitor … notify the attending' recommendations, 'discharged in stable condition' boilerplate; once a dictated 'Stop the nebulizers' was dropped from the discharge medications

Tickets: TFA-92599 / TFA-92592 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev (25acd727)

Note: Dev, 10 live visits (TC-21/S19): structure 10/10, billing 10/10, content 7 pass / 2 fail / 1 unsure (below the 3.2 bar); a person must confirm each fail.

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S19 Doc review: surviving templates match prototype p72, SNF consult/discharge are built new, retention windows are config values on the server clock

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 SNF Consult and SNF Discharge are built new, confirmed not present in the current prototype, not a port (TFA-92599 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • T2 Content and formatting of each surviving template still match the prototype exactly (TFA-94229) (TFA-92599 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U7j Retention windows are configuration values (not hard-coded), the clocks use server time, and the purge runs on the server (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (TFA-94229), the app's templates, and convex/lib/lifecycle.ts plus the purge job

When Compare section headings and formatting of the 6 surviving templates; confirm SNF consult/discharge are not ports; read where the retention windows and the clock come from

Then The 6 survivors match exactly; 2 new SNF templates exist; every 3.6 window is a configuration value (not hard-coded), the clocks are server time, and the purge runs on the server

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Side-by-side review by a person. Facts to start from: on e02167f the windows are `as const` objects HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts. Whether a source constant counts as the 'configuration value' 3.6 asks for (lengthened later under a hospital affiliation) is the reviewer's call. SNF consult/discharge are not built (known: TFA-92599 AC 2).

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92599 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

Nursing Home has no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge note (a consult resident gets the follow-up template), and expired patient data is purged only while a physician has the app open, so it can stay stored past its window.

Evidence: allure-results/52dc0692… (code review). (a) There is no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge template, and a consult falls back to snf-progress: dev report §4 / U43, TFA-92599 AC 2 knownGap. (b) There is no purge cron (crons.ts has only the session sweep), so retention runs only when a client calls applyLifecycle. That is already recorded as OAT-04 K3 and TC-19 U14b under TFA-94699 AC 7. Whether the windows, which are source constants, count as 'config values' needs sign-off.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: CODEREVIEW · Code review; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev/newspec-c.

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Dev 25acd727 (deployed 2026-10-15 14:04Z), live models (every call Haiku 4.5, no fallback), run 19:25-19:28 JST under runs/.dev.lock and the dev-session run lock (ctx-tc21-dev.spec.ts); only rows named 'QA TC21-CTX …' and two 'QA TC21-CTX …' templates were created, all deleted (cleanup: 12 rows deleted, 0 left, no other row of the account changed). Structure, judged against the v1.0 template text: 10/10 notes have every section in order (consult: Reason for Consultation … Recommendations and the closing sentence, no signature or date line; discharge: Admission Date … Time Spent on Discharge, 'Time spent on discharge: N minutes' or 'Not dictated'), no bracket placeholder, never 'yesterday'. Content (dictated facts only, as the template and TFA-92592 'The note reflects only what was dictated' require): 7 pass, 2 FAIL, 1 UNSURE, below 3.2's 9/10. FAIL c1-confusion: consulting service 'Geriatric Medicine' invented (the earlier run wrote 'Internal Medicine'), 'delirium' added as the impression, and Recommendation 5 'Monitor mental status closely and notify the attending physician if confusion worsens…' was never dictated (the template allows a monitoring or notify instruction only when dictated). FAIL d3-time25: Condition at Discharge 'The resident is discharged in stable condition.' and Course 'The resident tolerated the course and is now ready for discharge.' — boilerplate the template forbids (no condition was dictated, so it must read 'Not dictated.'). UNSURE c3-edema: 'possible early heart failure' / 'early pulmonary edema' as the impression and 'monitor for continued weight loss or gain' added to the dictated daily weights. Minor in passing notes: 'PO' added to dictated doses (d1, d5), the dictated ambulation filed under Condition while Functional Status reads 'Not dictated.' (d1, d4), an undictated rationale for holding aspirin (c5). Earlier run (19:19, same build, 4 visits, ctx-1919): the same confusion consult again invented a service and added 'notify the attending' / 'close monitoring', and a discharge dictation 'Stop the nebulizers.' produced a note with 'Discharge Medications: Not documented in chart provided' and no mention of the nebulizers (a dictated stop dropped; the 19:25 run of the same text kept it). A person confirms each FAIL / UNSURE before it is filed (grading rule).

Product issue: Notes written with the new SNF consult and SNF discharge templates sometimes contain things the physician never said: an invented consulting service, a 'delirium' or 'heart failure' impression, 'monitor … and notify the attending' recommendations, and 'discharged in stable condition' boilerplate; once a dictated medication stop was left out of the discharge medications.

Evidence: 2 attached; 3 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/ctx-1925/evidence/ctx-dev-e1-c1-confusion.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/ctx-1925/evidence/ctx-dev-e1-d3-time25.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/ctx-1925/evidence/ctx-dev-e1-c3-edema.png — a dev screenshot, not attached

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This dev newspec-c result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

Todo T2 (TFA-94229, in pro…
  • [local code-review] failed · product (code-review/results.json) — code-review: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane wrote no productIssue; counted from its physicianImpact)) This is a fail. One failing point is decided now and is not in the matrix, and one recorded gap applies. (a) Templates offered. The prompt library has 12 templates.
